Warren Buffett says one habit separates wealthy people from the rest.

Kevin Trudeau recalls it: wealthy people always put time and money into personal development, especially when they are just starting out. People who struggle tend not to.

Kevin says the difference is being teachable. If you want to become successful, you have to listen to the right people.

What have you invested in yourself lately?
